src: 能為他說。 善持淨戒， 渴仰大乘，
tgt: They upheld well the untainted moral precepts and prized Mahayana.

src: 既自充足， 復能充足餘渴仰者。
tgt: Already they were well contented within themselves and they made others feel well contented who prized Mahayana.

src: 善能攝取無上智慧， 愛樂大乘，
tgt: They imbibed the unsurpassed Wisdom very well, loved and protected Mahayana.

src: 守護大乘。 善能隨順一切世間， 度未度者， 解未解者。 紹三寶種使不斷絕， 於未來世當轉法輪， 以大莊嚴而自莊嚴， 心常深味清淨戒行， 悉能成就如是功德，
tgt: They accorded well with the ways of the world, passed those who had not yet gained the Way to the other shore of life, emancipated those not yet emancipated, and protected the seed of the Three Treasures so that it would not die out and so that, in days to come, they could turn the wheel of Dharma, adorn themselves greatly, deeply taste the pure moral precepts, attain accomplishment in all such virtues, have a great compassionate heart towards all beings, being impartial and not-two, and see all beings just as one views one’s own only son.

src: 於諸眾生生大悲心， 平等無二如視一子。 亦於晨朝日初出時， 為欲闍毘如來身故， 人人各取香木萬束、栴檀沈水、牛頭栴檀、天木香等， 是一一木，
tgt: Also, early in the morning when the sun had just risen, in order to cremate the Tathagata’s body, people each held in their hands tens of thousands of bundles of such fragrant wood as sandalwood, aloes, goirsa sandalwood, and heavenly wood, which had annual rings and heart and which all shone out in the wonderful hues of the seven treasures.

src: 文理及附， 皆有七寶微妙光明， 譬如種種雜彩畫飾， 以佛力故有是妙色， 青黃赤白，
tgt: For example, the various hues were like painted colours, all of which wonders having arisen out of the power of the Buddha, and which were blue, yellow, red, and white.

src: 為諸眾生之所樂見。
tgt: These were pleasing to beings’ eyes.

src: 大火、大水及大風等，
tgt: There are holocausts, great floods, typhoons, and the like.

src: 是諸難起， 皆應受持、講說此般若波羅蜜多。 若於是經受持、讀誦，
tgt: When these difficulties arise everyone should receive and keep, read and recite this Perfect Wisdom [scripture].

src: 一切所求——官位、富饒、男女、慧解、行來隨意、人天果報——皆得滿足；
tgt: If, as [stipulated] i n the scripture, people receive and keep, read and recite, everything they seek—official position, abundant wealth, sons and daughters, wisdom and understanding—will come according to their wishes. Human and celestial rewards will all be attained and fulfilled.

src: 疾疫厄難即得除愈；
tgt: Illness and difficulty will be totally eradicated.

src: 杻械枷鏁撿繫其身皆得解脫；
tgt: [Those with ] bonds and fetters, cangues and locks encumbering their bodies will all be liberated.

src: 破四重戒、作五逆罪及毀諸戒無量過咎悉得消滅。 「大王！ 往昔過去釋提桓因為頂生王， 領四軍眾來上天宮欲滅帝釋。 時彼天主即依過去諸佛教法，
tgt: [Those who have] broken the four most serious prohibitions, committed the five heinous crimes, or even violated all the prohibitions [will see their] limitless transgressions all be completely wiped out."

src: 首戴花冠， 垂右足。
tgt: Upon his head he wears a floral crown, and his right leg is pendent.

src: 畫像了， 泥壇。
tgt: After painting the image, smear the altar [with ox dung?]

src: 始自三月三日，
tgt: and begin [the following rite] from the third day of the third month.

src: 東面像向西， 以種種廣大供具、蘇乳蘇燈供養。
tgt: Face east toward the image, which is to face west, and make offerings of butter lamps and all other sorts of excellent offerings for twenty-eight days.

src: 二十八日乃至百日， 須清淨潔淨。
tgt: Up until the one-hundredth day, one must cleanse and purify oneself.

src: 比丘及傳法利生之師， 恩不已失，
tgt: For a bhikṣu [monk], when it comes to the kindness of the master who has transmitted this method for the benefit of the living, he must not be delinquent in this timing.

src: 時我常檀那家及國土放大光明，
tgt: [In this way,] I will always shine great rays of light upon the household and kingdom of the dāna[pati] [donor].

src: 成就錦繡羅綿財絹縺緻之類，
tgt: He or she will obtain all kinds of rich brocades, patterned silks, money, firm silks, and fine woven silks.

src: 金寶積如山岳， 世間受用咨(矣)。
tgt: Treasures of gold will pile up like a mountain for all the world to enjoy!

src: 「若有一國一人修行， 我本誓故， 普天率土民家皆悉如前所說，
tgt: If there is but one person in a kingdom who puts into practice my original vow, all the people of the entire kingdom will be as said before.

src: 財利莊嚴具成就。 一人莫乏有患，
tgt: Completely perfecting wealth and adornments, not a single person will be poor or have sickness.

src: 我本願皆悉為莊嚴財寶。
tgt: My original vow is that all will be adorned with riches.

src: 於若法至疑惑之心， 發起不信之念， 不成就一世之願故， 後世之果不定。
tgt: If this method attains to a mind of doubt, which gives rise to thoughts of disbelief, and the vows of one generation are not realized, then the fruits of future generations will be uncertain.

src: 好好以堅固之情歸於法， 非忌傳授之德，
tgt: It is best to take refuge in this method with a feeling of resolution, and not shun the virtue that has been transmitted.

src: 我必日日時時加護念， 圓滿世間第一妙樂之財利。
tgt: [Thus] I shall, continuously day after day, hold to this thought of divine protection: I will fill the entire world with the profit and riches of the utmost sublime bliss.

src: 如向所說， 係念本誓，
tgt: If one seeks that of which I have spoken, one must fix one’s mind upon this original vow.

src: 向寶壇前作契印念誦。
tgt: Standing before and facing the precious platform, form [the following] mudrā and recite [the above mantra].

src: 屈左中指無名指， 以大母指押彼二指甲， 舒頭指及小指安心上，
tgt: Bend the middle finger and ring finger of the left hand, and with the thumb press these two fingernails [against the palm]. Extend the forefinger and pinky finger and place [the hand] upon the heart.

src: 右手把數珠念真言，
tgt: With the right hand [count] the recitations of the mantra with a rosary.

src: 此名玉環成就一切所願印。
tgt: This is called the Jade-Bracelet-All-Vow-Fulfilling mudrā.

src: 此契印， 末代愚學之妄， 不可記於文字。
tgt: In the age of the Final [Dharma], ignorant [people] of shallow learning will be unable to record this mudrā in written words.

src: 萬人中撰十人， 十人之中撰一人， 許可(矣)。
tgt: Among ten thousand people ten will be chosen, and among ten people one will be chosen and permitted [to receive the transmission of this teaching].

src: 一切法者略有五種：
tgt: All dharmas may be generally grouped into five categories: One, Mind Dharmas.

src: 一者心法、二者心所有法、三者色法、四者心不相應行法、五者無為法。
tgt: Two, Dharmas interactive with the Mind. Three, Form Dharmas. Four, Dharmas Not interactive with the mind. Five, unconditioned Dharmas.

src: 一切最勝故， 與此相應故， 二所現影故， 三分位差別故， 四所顯示故。 如是次第。
tgt: They are in this sequence because the first are supreme, the second interact with the first, the third are the shadows manifest by the previous two, the fourth are the positions in which the previous three are not found, and the last are revealed by the previous four.

src: 第一心法， 略有八種：
tgt: The first, Mind Dharmas, include in general eight: 1.

src: 一眼識、二耳識、三鼻識、四舌識、五身識、六意識、七末那識、八阿賴耶識。 第二心所有法，
tgt: The Eye consciousness, II. The Ear consciousness, III. The Nose consciousness, IV. The Tongue consciousness, V. The body consciousness, VI. The mind consciousness, VII. The Manas consciousness, VIII. The Alaya consciousness. The second, dharmas interactive with the mind, include, in general, fifty-one. They are divided into six categories: 1, The Five universally interactive, II. The five particular states, III. The eleven wholesome, IV.

src: 略有五十一種， 分為六位： 一遍行有五、二別境有五、三善有十一、四煩惱有六、五隨煩惱有二十、六不定有四。
tgt: The six fundamental afflictions, V. The twenty derivative afflictions, and VI. The four unfixed. 1. The Five universally interactive are: 1. attention, 2.

src: 一遍行五者， 一作意、二觸、三受、四想、五思。
tgt: Contact, 3. feeling, 4, conceptualization, and 5, deliberation.

src: 二別境五者， 一欲、二勝解、三念、四定、五慧。
tgt: The Five particular states are: 1, Desire, 2. resolution, 3. recollection, 4. Concentration, and 5, judgment.

src: 三善十一者，
tgt: III, The eleven wholesome Dharmas are: 1.

src: 一信、二精進、三慚、四愧、五無貪、六無嗔、七無癡、八輕安、九不放逸、十行捨、十一不害。
tgt: Faith, 2. Vigor, 3. Shame, 4. Remorse, 5. Absence of greed, 6. Absence of anger, 7. Absence of Stupidity, 8. Light Ease, 9. Non-Laxness, 10. renunciation, 11.

src: 四煩惱六者，
tgt: Non-Harming. IV, The Six fundamental afflictions are: 1, Greed, 2.

src: 一貪、二嗔、三慢、四無明、五疑、六不正見。
tgt: Anger, 3. Stupidity, 4. Arrogance, 5. Doubt, and 6, Improper Views.

src: 五隨煩惱二十者， 一忿、二恨、三惱、四覆、五誑、六諂、七憍、八害、九嫉、十慳、十一無慚、十二無愧、十三不信、十四懈怠、十五放逸、十六惛沈、十七掉舉、十八失念、十九不正知、二十散亂。
tgt: v. The twenty afflictions are: 1. wrath, 2. hatred, 3. rage, 4. covering, 5. deceit, 6. flattery, 7. conceit, 8. harming, 9. jealousy, 10. stinginess, 11. Lack of shame, 12. Lack of Remorse, 13. Lack of Faith, 14. Laziness, 15.

src: 六不定四者，
tgt: Laxness, 16. Torpor, 17. restlessness, 18. Distraction, 19. Improper knowledge, and 20. scatteredness. vi. The Four unfixed are: 1.

src: 一睡眠、二惡作、三尋、四伺。
tgt: Sleep, 2. regret, 3. examination, and 4. investigation.

src: 第三色法，
tgt: The third is the Form Dharmas.

src: 略有十一種：
tgt: In general, there are eleven kinds: I.

src: 一眼、二耳、三鼻、四舌、五身、六色、七聲、八香、九味、十觸、十一法處所攝色。
tgt: Eyes, II. Ears, III. Nose, IV. Tongue, v. Body, vi. Forms, VII. Sounds, VIII. Smells, IX. Flavors, X. Objects of Touch, XI. Dharmas pertaining to form.

src: 第四心不相應行法，
tgt: The fourth is the Dharmas not interactive with the mind.

src: 略有二十四種：
tgt: In general, there are twenty-four: II.

src: 一得、二命根、三眾同分、四異生性、五無想定、六滅盡定、七無想報、八名身、九句身、十文身、十一生、十二老、十三住、十四無常、十五流轉、十六定異、十七相應、十八勢速、十九次第、二十方、二十一時、二十二數、二十三和合性、二十四不和合性。
tgt: Attainment (aquisition). II. Llfe-Faculty, III, Generic Similarity, IV. dissimilarity, V. The No-Thought Samadhi, VI. The Samadhi of extinction, VII.

src: 第五無為法者，
tgt: The Reward of No Thought, VIII.

src: 略有六種：
tgt: Bodies of Nouns, IX. Bodies of sentences, X. Bodies of phonemes, XI. Birth, XII. dwelling, XIII. Aging, XIV. impermanence, XV. revolution, XVI. distinction, XVII. interaction, XVIII. Speed, XIX. sequence, XX. Time, XXI. direction, XXII. numeration, XXIII. combination, XXIV.

src: 一虛空無為、二擇滅無為、三非擇滅無為、四不動滅無為、五想受滅無為、六真如無為。
tgt: discontinuity. The fifth is the unconditioned Dharmas, of which there are, in general, six: I, unconditioned Empty space, II. unconditioned extinction which is Attained by selection, III. unconditioned extinction which is unselected, IV. Unconditioned unmoving extinction, V. unconditioned extinction of Feeling and thinking, VI. unconditioned true suchness.

src: 言無我者，
tgt: What is meant by there being no self?

src: 略有二種： 一補特伽羅無我、二法無我。
tgt: There are, in general, Two Kinds of Non-self: 1. the Non-self of Pudgala, and 2. the Non-self of Dharmas.

src: 及來乞者？ 彼諸有情， 從此命終， ⽣餓鬼界，
tgt: Upon their death, these people will descend into the realms of hungry ghosts or animals.

src: 或傍⽣趣。 由昔 ⼈間， 曾得暫聞藥師琉璃光如來名故， 今在惡趣， 暫得憶念彼如來名， 即 於念時，
tgt: However, if they have briefly heard the name of the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata when they were humans, although now they are reborn into the wretched destines, if they can recall the Buddhas name even briefly, they will immediately be free from these destinies and be reborn as human beings.

src: 從彼處沒， 還⽣⼈中； 得宿命念， 畏惡趣苦，
tgt: They will remember their sojourn in the lower destinies, and, dreading their past sufferings, cease to wallow in worldly pleasures.

src: 不樂欲樂， 好⾏惠 施， 讚歎施者，
tgt: They will gladly practice dana, praise others who do so, and will no longer be ungenerous.

src: ⼀切所有， 悉無貪惜， 漸次尚能以頭目⼿手⾜， ⾎血⾁身分， 施來求者， 況餘財物？ 復次，
tgt: Gradually, they will even be able to donate their heads, eyes, limbs, blood, flesh, or other parts of their bodies to those who need them, not to mention mere material possessions.

src: 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 雖於如來受諸學處， ⽽破⼫羅； 有雖不破 ⼫羅，
tgt: Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentients beings who accept the teachings of the Tathagata but have violated the precepts; or, they have not violated the precepts, but have broken the regulations.

src: ⽽破軌則； 有於⼫羅軌則， 雖得不壞， 然毀正見； 有雖不毀正見， ⽽棄多聞， 於佛所說契經深義， 不能解了；
tgt: Or else, while they do not violate the precepts or the regulations, they have disparaged right views; or they have not disparaged right views but have abandoned extensive study of the Dharma and therefore cannot understand the profound meaning of the sutras preached by the Buddha.

src: 有雖多聞， ⽽增上慢，
tgt: Or else, although they may be knowledgeable, they have grown conceited in their Dharma knowledge.

src: 由增上慢， 覆蔽⼼故， 自是非他，
tgt: Because conceit clouds the mind, they believe that they are always right and others are the wrong.

src: 嫌謗正法， 為魔伴黨。
tgt: Or, they deprecate the right Dharma, thereby allying themselves with demons.

src: 如 是愚⼈， 自⾏邪見， 復令無量俱胝有情， 墮大險坑。
tgt: Such deluded persons not only follow wrong view themselves, but also lead countless other sentient beings into great dangerous pitfall.

src: 此諸有情， 應於地獄 傍⽣鬼趣， 流轉無窮。
tgt: These sentient beings are bound to wander endlessly on the paths of hell, animals, and hungry ghosts.

src: 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號， 便捨惡⾏， 修諸 善法， 不墮惡趣；
tgt: Yet, if they should hear the name of the Medicine Buddha, they will abandon evil conduct, cultivate good deeds, and avoid descending into the wretched destinies.

src: 設有不能捨諸惡⾏、修⾏善法， 墮惡趣者， 以彼如來本 願威⼒， 令其現前，
tgt: Even those who descend into the wretched destinies because they cannot abandon evil practices or cultivate good deeds, they can still benefit from the marvelous power of the Medicine Buddhas original vows.

src: 暫聞名號， 從彼命終， 還⽣⼈趣， 得正見精進， 善調 意樂，
tgt: If they should hear his name even briefly, at the end of their lives they will be reborn in the human realm, hold right views, be diligent, pursue right liveliood, and discipline their minds to attain joy.

src: 便能捨家， 趣於非家，
tgt: They will then be able to abandon home life to become monastics.

src: 如來法中， 受持學處， 無有毀犯，
tgt: They will uphold and study the Dharma of the Tathagatas without disparaging or violating it.

src: 正見多聞， 解甚深義， 離增上慢， 不謗正法，
tgt: With right views and extensive study, they will fathom the extremely profound meaning [of the teachings], be free from arrogance, and cease to disparage the right Dharma.

src: 不為魔伴， 漸次修⾏諸菩薩⾏， 速得圓滿。
tgt: They will no longer have demons as companions, but will gradually cultivate the practices of bodhisattvas and swiftly perfect them.

src: 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 慳貪嫉妒， 自讚毀他，
tgt: Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentient beings who are miserly, avaricious, envious, jealous, praise themselves, and disparage others.

src: 當墮三惡趣中， 無量千歲， 受諸劇苦！
tgt: They are bound to sink into the three wretched destinies, suffering intense misery for countless thousands of years.

src: 受劇苦已， 從彼命終， 來⽣⼈間， 作⽜馬駝驢，
tgt: When this intense suffering comes to an end, they will be reborn in the human world as oxen, horses, donkeys or camels.

src: 恆被鞭撻， 饑渴逼 惱， 又常負重， 隨路⽽⾏。
tgt: Often beaten and suffering from hunger and thirst, they constantly travel along the road carrying heavy loads.

src: 或得為⼈， ⽣居下賤， 作⼈奴婢， 受他 驅役， 恆不自在。
tgt: If they are reborn as human beings, they will be among the poor and lowly, always serving others and belabored by others, enjoying no freedom.

src: 若昔⼈中， 曾聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號， 由此 善因， 今復憶念， ⾄⼼歸依。
tgt: However, if any of them, in a former incarnation as a human being, have heard the name of the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and as a result of this good cause, now remember and wholeheartedly take refuge in him, they will, thanks to this Buddhas spiritual powers, be freed from all suffering.

src: 以佛神⼒， 眾苦解脫， 諸根聰利， 智 慧多聞， 恆求勝法， 常遇善友，
tgt: Their senses will be sharp and they will be wise and learned, constantly seeking the supreme teachings, and meeting with good spiritual friends.

src: 永斷魔羂， 破無明殼， 竭煩惱河， 解脫⼀切⽣老病死， 憂愁苦惱。
tgt: They will break forever through Maras net, smash the shell of delusion, dry up the river of afflictions, and thus escape all the worry and suffering of birth, old age, illness, and death.

src: 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 好喜乖離， 更相⾾訟，
tgt: Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentient beings who love to quarrel, create schisms, and engage in legal disputes.

src: 惱亂自他， 以身語 意， 造作增長種種惡業，
tgt: They make themselves and others suffer, creating and increasing all kinds of evil karma with body, speech, and mind.

src: 展轉常為不饒益事， 互相謀害。 告召⼭林樹塚等 神； 殺諸眾⽣， 取其⾎血⾁祭祀藥叉、羅剎婆等；
tgt: They plot against one another without mercy, while invoking the spirits of mountains, forests, trees, and tombs, they kill sentient beings and use their flesh and blood as sacrifices to the yaksa and raksara demons.

src: 書怨⼈名， 作其形像， 以 惡咒術， ⽽咒詛之； 魘魅蠱道， 咒起屍鬼，
tgt: They may also write down the names and make images of those against whom they harbor grudges, curse them with evil mantras or try to harm or kill them with potions, witchcraft, or demons revived from the dead.

src: 令斷彼命， 及壞其身。 是諸有 情， 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號， 彼諸惡事， 悉不能害 ⼀切展轉，
tgt: However, if the victims succeed in hearing the name of the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, none of these evil practices can harm them.

src: 皆起慈⼼， 利益安樂，
tgt: Moreover, everyone concerned will develop compassionate minds, endeavoring to benefit and bring peace and joy to others.

src: 無損惱意及嫌恨⼼， 各各歡悅，
tgt: Without harmful thoughts and angry spiteful minds, everyone will be happy and content.

src: 於自所 受， ⽣於喜⾜， 不相侵凌， 互為饒益。 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若有四眾： 苾芻、苾芻尼、鄔波索迦、鄔波斯迦， 及餘 淨信善男⼦、善⼥⼈等， 有能受持⼋分齋戒， 或經⼀年，

tgt: [Dormant] within the numen are spirits, and within the spirits are bodies.

src: 無為變化。 各稟乎自然。
tgt: No action, yet change and transformation—each endowed with spontaneity.

src: 微有事用。 漸有形名。
tgt: Subtly there arise phenomena and functions, and gradually there develop forms and names.

src: 形興未質。 名起未名。
tgt: Forms emerge from that which has no substance, and names arise from that which has no name.

src: 形各既兆。 遊氣亂清。
tgt: As forms and names multiply, the roaming pneumas confuse [what was] pure.

src: 寂兮寥兮。 寬兮廓兮。 分兮別兮。
tgt: [First] quiescent and still; [then] spacious and open; [finally] divided and differentiated.

src: 上則有君。 下則有臣。
tgt: Above are the lords and below the ministers.

src: 父子親其居。 尊卑異其位。
tgt: Fathers and sons draw close in their dwellings, while the noble and the base distinguish their ranks.

src: 起教敘其因。
tgt: They give rise to teachings and assess their consequences.

src: 然後國分其界。 人部其家。 各守其位。
tgt: Thereupon the state divides into realms and people into clans, each protecting their own positions.

src: 禮義興行。 有善可稱。 有惡可名。 善人所重。 惡人所輕。
tgt: The practice of rites and righteousness flourishes; there is “good” that can be lauded and “evil” that can be named, and the good is respected by people and evil disdained.

src: 於是即是非而競生。
tgt: Thereupon there is affirmation and negation, and strife is born.

src: 其智有解。 其愚有縛。
tgt: In understanding lies freedom, but ignorance brings bondage.

src: 上施煩形。 下無寂樂。
tgt: Those above hand down proscriptions such that those below know neither peace nor joy.

src: 失自然之志。 拘物外之約。
tgt: They lose their spontaneous will and impede their connection to the transcendent.

src: 迷無為之為。 動有作之作。
tgt: They stray from the efficacy of nonaction, and their movements have the makings of purpose.

src: 其名教既行。
tgt: Acting in accord with the doctrine of names, they force everything together into patterns of correspondence.

src: 使上下之應諾爾乃聲立五音。 色立五色。 行立五行。 德立五德。
tgt: In this manner sounds are organized according to the five modes, color according to the five colors, the phases according to the five phases, and virtue according to five virtues.

src: 差之毫釐。 過犯山嶽。
tgt: Thus, if one errs by so much as a hair’s breadth, the transgression is as great as a lofty mountain.

src: 律禁未然。 令防未欲。
tgt: Laws arise to prohibit that which has yet to occur, and orders are issued against urges people are yet to have.

src: 無放蕩之寬。 有多方之局。
tgt: Without the vastness of the disordered and free, there is naught but a host of distinctions.

src: 所以然者。 為人而不知足。
tgt: All this because people do not know when enough is enough.

src: 斯為濁亂之時。 有弟有師。
tgt: In these corrupt and disordered times, there are students and there are teachers.

src: 師有所訓。 弟有所依。
tgt: The teachers cling to their traditions, and the students remain obedient to them.

src: 天地寥落。 宇宙寬廓。
tgt: Heaven and earth are endless; the cosmos is vast and wide.

src: 中有煙塵。 清虛翳膜。
tgt: Within there is smoke and dust, veiling the pure void.

src: 巍巍之形。 內神外靈。
tgt: Forms loom large; spirit lies within and the numen without.

src: 妄有想慮。 真一闇冥。
tgt: Delusion gives rise to discursive thought, obscuring the True One in darkness.

src: 其妄有識。 其真有惑。
tgt: From delusion arises sentience, and truth becomes muddled.

src: 非取而取。 非得而得。
tgt: In the absence of [anything to] grasp, there is yet grasping; in the absence of [anything to] attain, there is yet attaining.

src: 是故理則無窮。 物則無極。
tgt: Therefore, the principle is inexhaustible, and things are without limit.

src: 動兮亂兮。
tgt: Movement! Confusion!

src: 內發三毒。
tgt: The three poisons arise from within.

src: 視兮聽兮。
tgt: Seeing! Hearing!

src: 外受五欲。
tgt: The five passions are stirred from without.

src: 其心慌慌。 其身忙忙。 觸物動作。 如火煌煌。
tgt: As the mind is agitated and the body bustles about, contact with objects moves one to action like the frenzied dance of fire.

src: 故聖人立正教。 置真謨。 使無知之侶。 上下相依。 修無為。
tgt: Therefore, the sages have established the correct teachings and laid out the true course so that those who lack in understanding—both superiors and inferiors—will rely on each other, cultivate nonaction, refrain from excess, and gradually reach suchness.

src: 息有餘。 漸至乎如如。 如如之理。 同本真軌。
tgt: The principle of suchness is identical with the original and true path.

src: 不可以修證。 不可以希冀。 惟寂滅性耳。
tgt: It cannot be cultivated, nor should it be the object of longing, for its nature is wholly quiescent and extinct.

src: 夫真也者。 無洲無渚。 無伴無侶。 無涯無際。 無處無所。
tgt: As for Truth, it is [a singular expanse] without island or shoal, without friend or peer, without limit or boundary, devoid of place or location, yet it acts as the progenitor of the myriad things.

src: 能為萬物之祖宗。 非目視。 非耳聞。
tgt: It cannot be seen by the eye nor heard by the ear.

src: 非形色。 非幻魂。 能為三界之根門。
tgt: It has neither shape nor form, nor is it a ghost, yet it acts as the fundamental gate to the three realms.

src: 其正者先離形。 次泯情。 不依物。 不拘生。
tgt: To correctly [grasp Truth] one must first part from form, then empty the emotions, become independent of things, and cease clinging to life.

src: 可以合大道通神明。
tgt: Then one can merge with the Great Way and penetrate the light of the spirit.

src: 有用曰神。 有形曰身。 無為曰道。 無相曰真。
tgt: That which functions is called spirit, and that which has form is called the body, while that which is without action is called the Way, and that which has no attributes is called Truth.

src: 應物而號。 隨物而造。
tgt: In response to things there is designation, and in accord with things there is creation.

src: 常住常存。 不生不老。
tgt: But that which abides eternally and exists eternally neither is born nor grows old.

src: 理合萬德。 事出千巧。
tgt: Principle merges with the ten thousand virtues, and phenomena emerge from the thousand arts.

src: 事雖無窮。 理終一道。
tgt: Although phenomena are inexhaustible, the Single Way ultimately lies in principle.

src: 無有證者。 無有得者。 然不證不得。 恒處心惑。
tgt: There is nothing to be realized, nothing to be attained, and yet if there is no realization or attainment, the mind will be forever confused.

src: 其心不真。 惑亂餘人。
tgt: This mind is false and brings confusion and turmoil to others.

src: 恍然惚然。 如有魍魎。 似有思想。
tgt: Nebulous and indistinct, it is like a shadowy phantom with only a semblance of intelligence.

src: 究兮推兮。 了無指掌。
tgt: Examine and ponder it; understanding is not [as simple as] pointing to the palm of your hand.

src: 如空忽雲。 如鏡忽塵。 彼此緣起。 而以妄存。
tgt: Like clouds appearing suddenly in the empty sky or dust appearing on the mirror—“this” and “that” arise only in dependence on conditions; they exist because of our delusion.

src: 有妄曰愚。 無妄曰真。
tgt: To be deluded is called ignorance, to be free of delusion is called Truth.

src: 真氷釋水。 妄水結氷。
tgt: Truth is like ice melting into water, and delusion like water freezing into ice.

src: 氷水之二。 其體不異。
tgt: In essence there is no difference between water and ice.

src: 迷妄曰愚。 惺真曰智。
tgt: To be confused and deluded is called ignorance, and to be awakened to Truth is called wisdom.

src: 其氷也冬不可釋。 其水也春不可結。 故愚不可即改。 智不可即待。
tgt: Just as ice cannot melt in winter and water cannot freeze in spring, so too ignorance cannot be ameliorated instantly, nor can wisdom be attained instantly.

src: 漸釋漸消。 以通乎大海。
tgt: Release comes gradually, as one slowly melts and dissolves into the great sea.

src: 斯可謂自然之道。
tgt: This can be called the natural way.

src: 寥寥冷坐少林。 默默全提正令，
tgt: In solitude he sits cool at Shorin; in silence the Right Decree’s fully revealed.

src: 秋清月轉霜輪， 河淡斗垂夜柄，
tgt: The autumn’s lucid and the moon’s a turning frosty wheel; the Milky Way’s pale, and the Big Dipper’s handle hangs low.

src: 繩繩衣鉢付兒孫， 從此人天成藥病。
tgt: In line the robe and bowl handed on to descendents henceforth are medicine to men and devas.

src: 東印請祖。
tgt: An Invitation for the Patriarch.

src: 示眾云。
tgt: PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY.

src: 劫前未兆之機。 烏龜向火。
tgt: By the activity existing before even a hint of this kalpa, a blind turtle faces the fire.

src: 教外別傳一句。 碓嘴生花。
tgt: By the phrase that’s transmitted outside the scriptures, a mortar’s rim spouts a flower.

src: 且道。 還有受持讀誦分也無。
tgt: Tell me: is there something to receive, maintain, read, and recite?

src: 舉。
tgt: Attention!

src: 東印土國王。 請二十七祖般若多羅齊。
tgt: The ruler of a country in Eastern India invited the Twenty-Seventh Ancestor, Hannyatara, for a midmorning meal.

src: 王問曰。 何不看經。 祖云。 貧道入息不居陰界。 出息不涉眾緣。
tgt: The ruler asked him, “Why don’t you read the sutras?” The Ancestor replied, “This poor follower of the Way, when breathing in does not dwell in the realm of skandhas, and when breathing out is not caught up in the many externals.

src: 常轉如是經。 百千萬億卷。 頌云。
tgt: Always do I thus turn a hundred thousand million billion rolls of sutras.” APPRECIATORY VERSE.

src: 雲犀玩月璨含輝， 木馬游春駿不羈，
tgt: Cloud rhino sports with the moon and glows embracing its beams; wooden horse plays in the spring, unfettered and fleet.

src: 眉底一雙寒碧眼， 看經那到透牛皮，
tgt: Beneath his brows, two chill blue eyes—what need to read sutras as though piercing oxhide!

src: 明白心起曠劫， 英雄力破重圍，
tgt: Bright white mind transcends vast kalpas, a hero’s strength tears through nested enclosures.

src: 妙圓樞口轉靈機。
tgt: The subtle round hub-hole turns marvelous activities.

src: 寒山忘却來時路。 拾得相將携手歸。
tgt: When Kanzan forgets the road whence he came, Jittoku will lead him by hand to return.

src: 世尊指地示眾云。
tgt: The World-Honored One Points to the Earth.

src: 一塵纔舉。 大地全收。
tgt: PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY. When a speck of dust is raised, the great earth is fully contained in it.

src: 疋馬單槍。 開疆展土。
tgt: It’s very well to open new territory and extend your lands with horse and spear.

src: 便可隨處作主。 遇緣即宗底。 是甚麼人。
tgt: Who is this person who can be master in any place and meet the source in everything?

src: 舉。
tgt: Attention!

src: 世尊與眾行次， 以手指地云。 此處宜建梵剎。 帝釋將一莖草。 插於地上云。
tgt: When the World-Honored One was walking with his disciples he pointed to the ground and said, “It would be good to erect a temple here.” The god Indra took a blade of grass and stuck it in the ground and said, “The temple has been erected.” The World-Honored One smiled faintly.

src: 建梵剎已竟。 世尊微笑。 頌云。
tgt: APPRECIATORY VERSE.

src: 百草頭上無邊春， 信手拈來用得親，
tgt: On the hundred grass-tips, boundless spring—taking what’s at hand, use it freely.

src: 丈六金身功德聚， 等閑携手入紅塵， 塵中能作主， 化外自來賓，
tgt: Buddha’s sixteen foot golden body of manifold merit spontaneously extending a hand, enters the red dust—within the dust he can be host coming from another world, naturally he’s a guest.

src: 觸處生涯隨分足， 未嫌伎倆不如人。
tgt: Wherever you are be content with your role—dislike not those more adept than you.

src: 其藥和竟， 還須千眼像前， 呪一千八遍， 著眼中，
tgt: The final mixture of the medicine should be brought immediately before a likeness of Thousand Eyes, the dhāraṇī recited 1,008 times, and then applied to the eyes.

src: 滿七日， 在深室慎風， 眼睛還生。
tgt: [After a full] seven days in a dark room free from any draught, the eyes will become clear again.

src: 青盲、白暈者， 光奇盛也。 「若患瘧病著者， 取虎、豹、犲、狼皮， 呪三七遍，
tgt: Any partial blindness or white haze [will have gone and the vision will] be bright and clear.’ ‘If someone is suffering in the grasp of a fever, get the skin of a tiger, wild cat, or wolf, recite the dhāraṇī three times, open [it up and] wrap it over their body [and the fever will] be immediately drawn out.

src: 披著身上， 即差。 師子皮最上。 若被蛇螫， 取被螫人結𦡲， 呪三七遍， 著瘡中， 即差。 「若患惡瘧， 入心悶絕欲死者， 取桃膠一顆， 大小亦如桃顆， 清水一升和煎，
tgt: Lion skin is the best.’ ‘If someone is bitten by a snake, get some earwax from that person, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times toward the earwax, apply it to the wound; then it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a grievous fever, [such that a] desire for death as the [only way to] end their pain enters their thoughts, get some peach gum, a lump the size of an actual peach, and boil it together with a pint of clean water [until] half a sheng [remains].

src: 取半升， 呪七遍， 頓服盡， 即差。
tgt: Then, recite the dhāraṇī seven times, drink it completely and [the fever will be] driven out.

src: 其藥莫使婦人煎。 「若患傳屍鬼氣、伏屍連病者， 取拙具羅香， 呪三七遍， 燒熏鼻孔中。
tgt: This medicine should not be prepared by a woman.’ ‘If someone is the carrier of a spirit or a vetāla, then to subdue the sickness bound to that corpse, get some guggul incense, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and burn it [so that its] smoke enters the nostrils.

src: 又取七丸如兔糞， 呪三七遍， 吞， 即差。
tgt: Then, take seven pills, about the size of a rabbit stool, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, swallow them, and it will be driven out.

src: 慎酒肉五辛及惡罵。 若取摩那屎羅(雄黃是也)， 和白芥子印成鹽， 呪三七遍， 於病兒床下燒，
tgt: Be cautious [about drinking] alcohol, [eating] meat or any of the Five Pungent [Roots], and using foul language.’ ‘If some realgar and white mustard seeds are ground with salt, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and burn it undern eath the bed of a sick child.

src: 其作病兒， 即魔掣迸走， 不敢住也。 「若患耳聾者， 呪胡麻油， 著耳中， 即差。 「若患一邊偏風， 耳鼻不通、手脚不隨者， 取胡麻油， 煎青木香， 呪三七遍，
tgt: Any malicious spirits will then be immediately driven out as they dare not linger.’ ‘If someone suffers from deafness in one ear, recite the dhāraṇī [over some] linseed oil, put it into the ear, and it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a Wind dysfunction that affects one side of the body causing it to sag, to be numb from nose to ear, and the arm and left side to not be responsive, then get linseed oil, and decoct with pipevine; recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and wipe it over the body with the hand [and the infliction] will be driven out forever.

src: 摩拭身上， 永得除差。 又方取純牛酥， 呪三七遍， 摩， 亦差。 「若患難產者， 取胡麻油， 呪三七遍， 摩產婦臍中及玉門中， 即易生。 「若婦人懷妊， 子死腹中， 取阿波末利伽草(牛膝草也)一大兩， 清水二升和煎，
tgt: Another method is to get ghee, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, rub [it in], and it will be driven out.’ ‘If a woman has difficulty in giving birth, get some sesame oil, recite the mantra three times seven times, rub it on to the navel and within the jade gate, and the birth will become easier.’ ‘If a woman is pregnant, and the child dies in her belly, get a large liang of prickly chaff flower grass and boil it in two sheng of clean water.

src: 取一升， 呪三七遍， 服， 即出一，
tgt: Take one sheng [of the decoction], recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and take it.

src: 無苦痛。 胎衣不出者，
tgt: Then, when it comes out, there will be no pain.

src: 亦服此藥， 即差。 「若卒患心痛不可忍者， 名『遁屍疰』， 取君柱魯香(薰陸香)， 乳頭成者一顆， 呪三七遍，
tgt: If the afterbirth does not come out, take more of this medicine and it will then be discharged.’ ‘If someone suddenly suffers from unbearable heart pain, described as the ‘grip of the hidden dead, get some frankincense incense, a piece in the shape of a nipple, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and put it into the mouth, chew, and swallow.

src: 口中嚼咽， 不限多少， 令變吐， 即差。
tgt: There is no fixed amount, [take whatever amount is needed] to cause vomiting, then it will be driven out.

src: 慎五辛、酒肉。 「若被火燒瘡， 取熱瞿摩夷(烏牛屎也)， 呪三七遍， 塗瘡上，
tgt: Be cautious [about consuming] any of the five pungent vegetables, alcohol, or meat.’ ‘If someone has burn blisters, get some warm dung from a black cow, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and spread it over the blisters.

src: 即差。 「若患蛔蟲齩心， 取骨魯末遮(白馬尿也)半升， 呪三七遍， 服， 即差。
tgt: They will soon go.’ ‘If someone is suffering from tapeworms or worms biting the heart, get some urine from a white horse, about half a sheng, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, take it, and these will soon be driven out.

src: 重者一升，
tgt: If severe, one sheng.

src: 蟲如綟索出來。 「若患丁瘡者， 取凌鎖葉擣取汁，
tgt: The worms will then come out like ropes.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a deep-rooted boil, get some astringent leaves and pound them.

src: 呪三七遍， 瀝著瘡上， 即拔根出， 立差。
tgt: Take the juice, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, apply by trickling it onto the boil, and then squeeze the root out.

src: 「若患蠅螫眼中， 骨魯怛佉(新驢屎也)濾取汁， 呪三七遍， 夜臥著眼中，
tgt: It will be released immediately.’ ‘If [someone] is suffering from eyes stung by flies, [get some] white donkey or mule dung, strain it to get the fluids, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and then, [when going to] sleep at night, put it into the eyes.

src: 即差。 「若患腹中痛， 和井華水， 和印成鹽三七顆，
tgt: It will soon go.’ ‘If [someone] is suffering from abdominal pains, mix well-flower water with crushed salt, three [times] seven lumps.

src: 呪三七遍， 服半升， 即差。 「若患赤眼者， 及眼中有努肉及有翳者， 取奢奢彌葉(苟杞葉也)， 擣濾取汁，
tgt: Recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, take a half sheng, and it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from red eyes, or someone has a growth on their eye or [their vision had become] cloudy, get some shami leaves, pound and strain to get the juice.

src: 呪三七遍， 浸青錢一宿， 更呪七遍，
tgt: Recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and soak a copper coin in it overnight.

src: 著眼中， 即差。 「若患畏夜， 不安恐怖， 出入驚怕者， 取白線作索， 呪三七遍， 作二十一結， 繫項， 恐怖即除。
tgt: Then, recite the dhāraṇī seven times, put it into the eyes, and it will soon be driven out.’ ‘If someone is afraid of the dark, is anxious, is terrified, or dreads coming and going, get some white thread and make a cord, [recite] the dhāraṇī three [times] seven [times], then make twenty-one knots, fasten it around [their] neck, and [their] fear will be cast out.

src: 非但除怖， 亦得滅罪。 「若家內橫起災難者， 取石榴枝， 寸截一千八段，
tgt: Not only will [their] fears be cast out, [whatever] evil [they fear] will be burnt away too.’ ‘If someone has a sudden misfortune befall [their] family, get a branch from a pomegranate [tree], cut it into 1,008 bits one cun [in length], spread butter and honey on both ends, recite the dhāraṇī once, and burn one piece [at a time].

src: 兩頭塗酥酪蜜， 一呪一燒， 盡千八遍，
tgt: At the end, [recite the dhāraṇī a further] 1,008 times.

src: 一切災難悉皆除滅，
tgt: All misfortunes will be completely gone, burnt away.

src: 要在佛前作之。 「若取白菖蒲， 呪三七遍， 繫著右臂上， 一切鬪處、論義處，
tgt: It is import ant to do this in front of a buddha [image].’ ‘If some calamus leaves are taken, the dhāraṇī [is recited] three times seven times, and [the leaves are] tied above the right forearm, [then] wherever there are disputes or wherever there are arguments, the [bearer] will always triumph over others.’ ‘If a leafy branch from a shami [tree] is taken and cut [into bits one] cun [in length], and ghee, white honey, and butter are spread over both ends, then for one [recitation of] the dhāraṇī, burn one [piece of the wood until all] 1,008 pieces [are burnt].

src: 皆得勝他。 「若取奢奢彌葉枝柯， 寸截， 兩頭塗真牛酥、白蜜牛酥， 一呪一燒， 盡一千八段， 日別三時， 時別一千八遍，
tgt: [Do this] three separate times per day, each time for 1,008 repetitions.

src: 火中燒， 還須塗酥酪蜜， 要須於大悲心像前作之。 若取胡嚧遮那(牛黃是也)一大兩， 著瑠璃瓶中， 置大悲心像前， 呪一百八遍， 塗身、點額， 一切天、龍、鬼、神、人及非人， 皆悉歡喜也。

src: 「若有身被枷鎖者， 取白鴿糞， 呪一百八遍， 塗於手上， 用摩枷鎖， 枷鎖自脫也。 「若有夫婦不和， 狀如水火者， 取鴛鴦尾， 於大悲心像前，

src: 呪一千八遍， 帶， 彼即終身歡喜相愛敬。 「若有被蟲食， 田苗及五果子者， 取淨灰、淨沙或淨水， 呪三七遍，
tgt: Then they will, until their lives’ end, be happy, loving, and respectful toward each other.’ ‘If seedlings in the fields or the five sorts of fruit on a farm are being eaten by bugs, get clean ash, clean sand, or clean water, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times.

src: 散田苗四邊， 蟲即退散也。

tgt: Sprinkle it on the fruits of the trees while [reciting the] dhāraṇī, and the grubs on the trees will not dare eat the fruit.’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘If [someone wishes] to become rich, to have wealth [such as the] various sorts of jewels and property, then make the wish-fulfilling gem mudrā.

src: 當於如意珠手。 若為種種不安求安隱者， 當於羂索手。
tgt: If it is to seek peace and tranquility during various sorts of unrest, then make the rope mudrā.

src: 若為腹中諸病， 當於寶鉢手。
tgt: If it is to [remedy] an illness of the abdomen, then make the jewel bowel mudrā.

src: 若為降伏一切魍魎鬼神者， 當於寶劍手。 若為降伏一切天魔神者，
tgt: If it is to subdue any spirit, monster, or yakṣa, then make the jewel sword mudrā. If it is to subdue any god of the Māra [realm], then make the vajra mudrā.

src: 當於跋折羅手。 若為摧伏一切怨敵者， 當於金剛杵手。
tgt: If it is to crush an enemy, then make the vajra-staff mudrā.

src: 若為一切處怖畏不安者， 當於施無畏手。
tgt: If it is to [overcome] any sort of fear and anxiety, then make the fearlessness-giving mudrā.

src: 若為眼闇無光明者， 當於日精摩尼手。
tgt: If it is [to heal] shadowy and unclear vision, then make the sunshine gem mudrā.

src: 若為熱毒病求清涼者， 當於月精摩尼手。
tgt: If it is to seek the cooling of some feverish illness, then make the moonshine gem mudrā.

src: 若為榮官益職者， 當於寶弓手。
tgt: If it is to [gain] esteemed office, or promotion, then make the jewel bow mudrā.

src: 若為諸善朋友早相逢者， 當於寶箭手。
tgt: If it is to [bring] together others, all as good friends, then make the jewel arrow mudrā.

src: 若為身上種種病者， 當於楊枝手。 若為除身上惡障難者， 當於白拂手。
tgt: If it is to [remedy] the various illnesses of the body, then make the tooth stick mudrā. If it is to drive evil obstacles and difficulties away from the body, then make the white whisk mudrā.

src: 若為一切善和眷屬者， 當於胡瓶手。
tgt: If it is to [establish] the good and [bring] harmony between followers, then make the [mixing] pot mudrā.

src: 若為辟除一切虎狼犲豹諸惡獸者， 當於旁牌手。
tgt: If it is to ward off any tiger, wolf, bear, leopard, and all [other sorts] of malicious beasts, then make the shield mudrā.

src: 若為一切時處好離官難者， 當於斧鉞手。
tgt: If it is to always live in a goodly place that turns away political strife, then make the battle-axe mudrā.

src: 若為男女僕使者， 當於玉環手。
tgt: If it is to [manage] male and female servants, then make the jade bracelet mudrā.

src: 若為種種功德者， 當於白蓮華手。
tgt: If it is to [gain] various sorts of merits, then make the white lotus mudrā.

src: 若為欲得往生十方淨土者， 當於青蓮華手。
tgt: If it is to [realize] the wish to go on to a birth in a pure land [somewhere] throughout the ten directions, then make the blue lotus mudrā.

src: 若為大智慧者， 當於寶鏡手。
tgt: If it is to [obtain] great wisdom, then make the jewel mirror mudrā.

src: 若為面見十方一切諸佛者， 當於紫蓮華手。
tgt: If it is to meet face [to face with] all the buddhas of the ten directions, then make the purple lotus mudrā.

src: 若為地中伏藏者， 當於寶篋手。
tgt: If it is to [find] treasures hidden in the ground, then make the jewel casket mudrā.

src: 若為仙道者， 當於五色雲手。
tgt: If it is to [tread] the path of the rishis, then make the five-color cloud mudrā.

src: 若為生梵天者， 當於軍遲手。 若為往生諸天宮者， 當於紅蓮華手。
tgt: If it is to [obtain] birth as a god in a pure realm, then make the [bathing] pot mudrā. If it is to [go on to] birth some heavenly mansion, then make the lotus mudrā.

src: 若為辟除他方逆賊者， 當於寶戟手。
tgt: If it is to subdue the opposition of others, then make the jewel spear mudrā.

src: 若為召呼一切諸天善神者， 當於寶螺手。 若為使令一切鬼神者， 當於髑髏杖手。
tgt: If it is to rally all devas and good yakṣas, then make the jewel conch mudrā. If it is to control ghosts and spirits, then make the ‘dead skull stick’ mudrā.

src: 若為十方諸佛速來授手者， 當於數珠手。 若為成就一切上妙梵音聲者， 當於寶鐸手。
tgt: If it is to [have] all the buddhas of the ten directions swiftly come and take [your] hand [at the moment of death], then make the counting-bead mudrā. If it is to achieve the fi nest, purest-sounding voice, then make the jewel bell mudrā.

src: 若為口業辭辯巧妙者， 當於寶印手。
tgt: If it is to be someone with the ability to speak with skillfully [chosen] words in a clever and admirable [way], then make the jewel seal mudrā.

src: 若為善神龍王常來擁護者， 當於俱尸鐵鉤手。
tgt: If it is to always have goodly spirits and the nāga kings come and [give their] protection, then make the rope and goad mudrā.

src: 若為慈悲覆護一切眾生者， 當於錫杖手。
tgt: If it is to compassionately safeguard e very living creature, then make the tin stick mudrā.

src: 若為一切眾生常相恭敬愛念者， 當於合掌手。
tgt: If it is for all living creatures to always respect and cherish each other, then make the ‘namaste’ mudrā.

src: 若為生生之處不離諸佛邊者， 當於化佛手。
tgt: If it is to never, from life to life, depart from the sides of all the buddhas, then make the transformation buddha mudrā.

src: 若為生生世世常在佛宮殿中， 不處胎藏中受身者， 當於化宮殿手。
tgt: If it is to forever, from birth to birth, and life to life, dwell in the mansion of a buddha, and not live in any body received from within any womb, then make the transformation palace mudrā.

src: 若為多聞廣學者， 當於寶經手。
tgt: If it is for hearing much and learning widely, then make the jewel sūtra mudrā.

src: 若為從今身至佛身， 菩提心常不退轉者， 當於不退金輪手。
tgt: If it is to never, from this present body until [obtaining] the body of a buddha, turn away from bodhicitta, then make the irreversible golden wheel mudrā.

src: 若為十方諸佛速來摩頂授記者， 當於頂上化佛手。
tgt: If it is to have all the buddhas of the ten directions come and rub the top of [one’s] head and grant the receipt of an account, then make the transformation buddha crown mudrā.

src: 若為果蓏諸穀稼者， 當於蒲萄手。
tgt: If it is for fruits, melons, and all [other] crops, then make the myrobalan mudrā.

src: 國祚身命， 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所受諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步軍等，

src: 應善勤修， 隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀， 於自命終常當驚懼， 為大國王應以正法勿以非法， 應隨法行勿隨非法。
tgt: You should properly and diligently practice the contemplation that follows impermanence(with each inbreath and outbreath), and the contemplation that follows cessation (with eachinbreath and outbreath); you should constantly be fearful of the end of your life; and you should reign aslord of your great state by means of righteous Dharma, and not by what is not Dharma; you should conductyourself in accordance with Dharma, and not in accordance with what is not Dharma.

src: 如四大山從四方來， 牢固堅密無有缺漏無諸間隙， 周匝充遍總一合成， 上盡虛空下窮地際， 其中所有一切草木枝條花葉，
tgt: Know that it is as if four great mountains were to approach from the four directions—solid and dense, without any gaps or apertures, without any cracks or fissures, fully rounded out on allsides, fused into a single mass, upward exhausting the reach of the heavens, and downward beggaring thelimit of the earth; and all the grasses, trees, branches, flowers and leaves between them, and the sentientbeings that crawl the earth, all these are obliterated—they cannot be escaped by resolve and bravery, theycannot be resisted with strength and might, and they cannot be staved off with spells, or wealth, or medicaments.Just so, O great king!

src: 及諸有情蠢動之類皆被磨滅， 難以決勇而可逃避， 難以勢力而能抗拒， 難以呪術財貨藥物而可禁止。 如是， 大王！ 世有四種大怖畏事， 各來磨滅一切眾生， 難以決勇而可逃避， 難以勢力而能抗拒，
tgt: there are in the world four monstrous horrors, which approach severally toobliterate all sentient beings—they cannot be escaped by resolve and bravery, they cannot be resisted withstrength and might, and they cannot be staved off with spells, or wealth, or medicaments.

src: 難以呪術財貨藥物而能禁止。 「云何四種大怖畏事？
tgt: What are thosefour monstrous horrors?

src: 大王當知！

src: 一者、老來逼害， 磨滅眾生少壯； 二者、病來逼害， 磨滅眾生調適； 三者、死來逼害， 磨滅眾生壽命； 四者、衰來逼害， 磨滅眾生興盛。
tgt: Know that the first is age, which comes pressing on us, oppressingus, and obliterates the youth of beings; the second is sickness, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us,and obliterates the health of beings; the third is death, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us, andobliterates the life of beings; and the fourth is decay, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us, and obliteratesthe flourishing of beings.

src: 譬如師子為眾獸王， 入鹿群中搏取一鹿， 若噉未噉自在無難。 其鹿爾時先所騰勇， 入師子口無復能為。
tgt: Know that we might liken it to a lion, who is king of the beasts, falling upon a herd ofdeer to seize one of the deer: whether or not he eats, he remains sovereign and untroubled; but the deer,which moments before was bounding away, falls into the lion’s maw, and there is nothing more it can do.Just so, O great king!

src: 如是， 大王！ 一切眾生既入無常師子王口， 所有勢力無復能為。
tgt: are all beings. As soon as they fall into the maw of the lion-king of impermanence, allthe power in the world can do nothing more for them.

src: 譬如有人勇健多力毒箭所中，
tgt: Know this: It is as if there were a man, brave, sturdy and strong, who is struck by apoisoned arrow.

src: 一切威猛皆悉摧滅。
tgt: All his valour and force is smashed and annihilated.

src: 如是， 大王！
tgt: Just so, O great king!

src: 一切眾生剛強佷戾， 死箭所中無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，
tgt: All beings,doughty and mighty as they may be, when they are struck by the arrow of death, no longer have any strength, no longer have any protection, no longer have anything to depend upon, no longer have anywhere to flee.

src: 臨欲捨命解支節時， 血肉枯竭心胸熱惱， 焦渴所逼張口大息， 手足紛亂無所堪能， 無有勢力涎涕交流， 大小便利穢污身體， 六根閉塞喉顙哽噎喘息逾急， 良醫拱手棄諸妙藥。 其所飲噉美味珍饌無不悉捨， 偃臥床枕臨往異趣淪沒無際， 生老病死無常瀑流，
tgt: On the verge of leaving this life, the limbs and members fall apart, and flesh and blood becomes arid and parched, and the heart is tormented by fever, and a parching thirst oppresses you, and the mouth gapes, and you breathe in great gasps, and your arms and legs flail chaotically; you can do nothing and have no strength; drool and tears flow together, and urine and excrement foul the body; the six faculties are sealed off; you gag with a guttural gurgle, panting ever more frantically; the best doctors fold their hands and put aside their wonder-drugs, and the treats and delicacies you supped upon without exception are cast aside; sprawled out on the deathbed, on the brink of heading for another rebirth destiny, you are tossed and plunged in the limitless, rough torrent of impermanence—of birth, aging, sickness and death; on the brink of the last station, when not a jot remains of life, by dint of the power vested in moral action (karma), the next existence looms into view before you, and you quail in terror of King Yama’s emissaries; swallowed up by the vast black night, you pant in and out; and at that very last, when annihilation is imminent, you are all alone, without any second or other companion; then suddenly you turn your back on this rebirth, and fall under the sway of the next life.

src: 至臨終位餘命無幾， 業有力故後有現前。 甚大怖畏琰魔王使， 廣大黑闇夜分所吞， 出息入息最後將滅， 唯獨一身無有第二及餘伴侶， 奄背此生歸於後世。 是大移轉趣大叢林，
tgt: This is the great transformation.

src: 入大黑闇遊大曠野， 泛大溟海業風所飄， 往無標記冥寞方所，
tgt: You go into the great jungle, enter the great darkness, wander the great wasteland, and drift on the face of the vast deep; you are tossed on the winds of karma, and head toward regions unmarked, obscure, and deserted.

src: 當於爾時無異救護、無異歸依、無異投竄， 唯除正法。
tgt: When that time comes, there is surely no other salvation, no other refuge, no other place to flee, except for righteous Dharma.

src: 大王！

src: 彼於爾時， 唯有正法能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依， 是所奔趣是所投竄， 能拔眾生出生死苦。
tgt: At that time, righteous Dharma is all there is that can serve as salvation, or can serve as a palace, or can function as a refuge, or is a direction to run, or is a place to flee to, or can pluck beings out of the woe of birth-and-death.. “O great king!

src: 「大王當知！ 譬如有人寒苦所逼， 唯有煖火日光衣等， 所能止息而可獲安； 熱苦所逼唯林泉等； 若涉遠道唯清涼陰；
tgt: Know that it is as if there were a person afflicted by the misery of cold—only a warm fire, or the light of the sun, or garments and the like can give him respite, so that he can find comfort; or one afflicted by the misery of heat, whose only respite is glades, springs, and so on; or one travelling a long road, whose only respite is cool shade; or one afflicted by thirst, whose only respite is pure, cold water; or one afflicted by hunger, whose only respite is ample, fine viands; or one afflicted by illness, whose only respiteis skilled physicians and nurses; or one afflicted by fear, whose only respite is a staunch companion.

src: 若渴所逼唯清冷水； 若飢所逼唯多美膳， 若病所逼惟良醫藥及供侍者； 若怖所逼惟強伴侶。 如是， 大王！

src: 如是身者， 雖加守護雖久洗飾， 雖以眾多上妙飲食恣意飽滿， 及至臨終， 要當不免飢渴所逼而便捨命。
tgt: Know that the body being thus, one might well lavish protection upon it; one might well for a long time wash it and adorn it; one might well sate it as much as one pleases with exquisite food and drink—but when one reaches the brink of the end of life, there is no way one will avoid dying oppressed by hunger and thirst.

tgt: Know that the body being thus, where formerly, you always rode perfumed elephants, or fine steeds, or bejewelled palanquins; with kettledrums beating and conches blasting, and a great fanfare struck up; followed behind by attendants shading you from the sun with jewelled canopies and flourishing yak-tail fly-whisks; with countless doughty and valiant regiments of elephant, horse, chariots and infantry, parading before and behind and guarding your left and right; with hundreds and thousands of ministers and courtiers sincerely singing your praises, and the people of the cities and towns saluting and cheering— although you might have enjoyed such excellent rewards as these, and power and glory, before long, you will certainly close your eyes, and stretch out your arms, and stir no more; your corpse will lie flat on its back on the funeral bier, and be carried by a throng out the gate of the city; and your parents, wives, children, brothers, sisters, menials, servants, courtiers, attendants, relatives and intimates will follow behind and on either side, their hearts trammelled by grief, their hair loose and unbound, raising their hands to bludgeon their heads, beating their breasts and dolefully keening, so shaken by grief they collapse, all wailing, ‘Woe!’ And the people of the cities and towns of the land, seeing them, will cry out a lament, and accompany the corpse to the funeral ground.

src: 防衛左右百千臣僚竭誠敬奉， 城邑士庶合掌驚歎。 雖受如是勝妙果報自在榮華， 不久要當瞑目辟手無復動搖， 橫屍偃仰喪車輿上， 眾人荷挽出大城門， 父母妻子兄弟姊妹作使僮僕群僚輔佐， 親屬內人隨從左右， 心纏憂惱頭髮被散， 舉手拍頭椎胸悲噎， 哀感崩慟皆言： 『苦哉！ 』城邑國人覩之號慕。 隨送葬所， 或有露屍施諸禽獸， 鳥鵲餓狗鵰鷲鵄梟， 狐狼野干及諸惡獸， 楂掣食噉骨肉狼籍， 風飃日曝雨漬霜封，

tgt: Know that just as the body is thus mutable, destructible, and impermanent, all beings, and all compounded things, are without exception similarly impermanent, inconstant, and not to be trusted; they are all mutable things, which hurtle onward ceaselessly, churning and shifting, destined for ultimate destruction; from moment to moment they slip away and decay, and finally turn to ash; in the end, they are uniformly bound for the maw of annihilation; they are perishable things, beset with terrors, attended by sudden calamity, and they multiply our woes; they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered.

tgt: And further, he perfects the five kinds of supernor-mal faculties and their actions of knowledge.

src: 云何名為五種神通？
tgt: What are known as the five kinds of supernormal faculties?

src: 一者天眼、二者天耳、三者他心、四者宿住、五者神境，
tgt: The first is the divine eye, the second is the divine ear, the third is [the knowledge of] the minds of others, the fourth is [the knowledge of] past lives, and the fifth is the base of ṛddhi.

src: 此說名為五種神通。
tgt: This explains what is called the five kinds of supernormal faculties.

src: 又復云何菩薩於彼天眼乃至神境而能圓滿最上正行神通智業？
tgt: And moreover, what does one say of the Bodhisattva, with regard to these, the divine eye, and so forth, down to the base of ṛddhi? He is able to perfect the supreme right practice of the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

src: 舍利子！ 此菩薩如實安住正等引心圓滿清淨， 純一無雜及隨煩惱，
tgt: Śāriputra, this Bodhisattva-mahāsattva truly abides securely in a rightly concentrated mind, with perfect purity and uniformity without mixture or secondary kleśas.

src: 於諸有情心無所欲， 而能發起神境等通，
tgt: With regard to sentient beings, his mind has nothing which is desired, and he is able to produce the faculties of the base of ṛddhi.

src: 此說名為神通智業。
tgt: This explains what are called the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

src: 又天眼清淨出過於人， 而能觀察諸有情等， 初生退沒好醜等相、善趣惡趣勝妙下劣， 乃至知諸有情業行差別，
tgt: Moreover, the purity of the divine eye surpasses that of men, and is able to behold all sentient beings, their birth, their passing away, their aspects of beauty, their ugliness, their good destiny, their evil destiny, their superiority, their inferiority, and also knows the different kinds of karma-practices of all sentient beings.

src: 身語意中具足惡行， 起彼邪見誹謗聖賢，
tgt: Because of their evil practices of body, speech and mind, they give rise to their wrong views and slander the No-buddha.

src: 而復積集邪見業因， 身謝命終墮於惡趣那落迦中。
tgt: "Liable ones, and further accumulating the karma and causes of wrong views, when the body dies and life ends, they descend into hell" of an evil destiny.

src: 又復知彼諸有情等身語意中具足善行， 起彼正見稱讚聖賢， 而復積集正見業因， 身謝命終生於善趣或生天界。
tgt: And moreover, he knows all those sentient beings endowed with virtuous practices of body, speech and mind, giving rise to their right views and praising the Noble Ones, and further, accumulating the karma and causes of right views, when the body dies and life ends, they are born in a good destiny and may be born in heavenly worlds.

src: 舍利子！ 以清淨天眼出過於人， 於諸有情積集惡業悉能了知。
tgt: Śāriputra, with the pure divine eye surpassing that of men, he can see in every detail the evil karma accumulated by sentient beings.

src: 舍利子！ 此菩薩摩訶薩清淨天眼， 於諸有情而為最勝，
tgt: Śāriputra, this pure divine eye of the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva is considered superior compared to that of sentient beings.

src: 色相明了悉無障礙，
tgt: It perceives forms and marks in every detail without obstruction.

src: 一切天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿脩羅， 有學無學大阿羅漢、辟支佛眾， 悉勝於彼， 最上最勝、最極明了、無有過上。
tgt: It is superior in every respect to that of all the devas, the nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, śaikṣas and aśaikṣas, great arhats and the host of Pratyekabuddhas, supreme, most superior, best in clear perception, having none which surpasses it.

src: 又此天眼， 於彼一切出離道中最勝出離。 而諸菩薩有是天眼，
tgt: Moreover, this divine eye, among all the paths of salvation, is the most superior salvation, and all Bodhisattvas possess this divine eye.

src: 於十方世界無量有情， 若麁若細、若勝若劣、若遠若近， 而此天眼諸有色相，
tgt: This divine eye knows in every detail, without any opposing obstruction, the measureless sentient beings of the worlds of the ten directions, whether gross or subtle, superior or inferior, far or near, and all that has form and marks.

src: 於彼了知悉無對礙。 又此天眼見色究竟， 除無色界， 所有十方世界無量有情， 若生若滅， 及彼業因一切根因，
tgt: Moreover, this heavenly eye sees the limit of form, and excepting the formless worlds, is able to know in every detail the measureless sentient beings which are in the worlds of the ten directions, their manner of ceasing, and their karma-causes and all their root-causes, and whether they increase or decrease, whether they are superior or inferior.

src: 若增若減若勝若劣， 悉能了知。 又彼所有十方世界諸佛剎土功德莊嚴， 一切悉見。
tgt: Moreover, he sees in every detail all the Buddha-lands which are in the worlds of the ten directions, and their merits and adornments.

src: 清淨戒蘊安住成就勝妙果報， 亦皆了知。
tgt: He also knows them all to purify the śīla-skandha* and securely abides in the development of samādhi and wonderful fruition.

src: 又彼清淨天眼出過於人， 諸佛世尊及菩薩眾一切悉見， 及彼正士正念正知、通達境界威儀道行， 及解脫法得總持門， 安住智慧善巧方便，
tgt: Moreover, his pure divine eye, surpassing that of men, sees in every detail all the Buddhas, the World-honored Ones, and the host of Bodhisattvas, and the right recollection and right knowledge of these worthy persons, penetrating the object-spheres, dignified in the practice of the Way, reaching to the Dharma of liberation and attaining the methods of dhāraṇī, abiding securely in prajñā and skillful upāyas.

src: 而能入解一切圓滿。
tgt: He is able to enter into the perfection of all these.

src: 彼眼無礙諸色無見， 彼眼無著諸色無染，
tgt: His eye is without obstruction [with regard to] forms, and is without views. His eye is without attachment to all forms and is without distain.

src: 彼眼解脫謂離諸見，
tgt: The liberation of his eye is described as free from all views.

src: 彼眼清淨自體光潔，
tgt: The purity of his eye is intrinsically radiant.

src: 眼無依止離諸境界， 眼無所取離諸煩惱，
tgt: His eye, without attachment, is free from the object-spheres. His eye, without craving, is free from the kleśas.

src: 眼無翳障離諸疑惑， 眼不起念離對礙法，
tgt: His eye, having no film, is free from doubts. His eye, not giving rise to recollection, is free from the dharmas of opposing obstructions.

src: 眼得光明照燭諸法，
tgt: His eye attains light and illuminates all dharmas.

src: 眼隨智慧離識境界，
tgt: His eye is in accordance with prajñā and is free from the object-spheres of vijñāna.

src: 彼眼無著離難調伏及彼癡冥一切煩惱。
tgt: His eye, without attachment, is free from what is hard to conquer, and its delusion and all kleśas.

src: 眼能決擇諸根幻化，
tgt: His eye can conjure up the facilities of penetration.

src: 又復眼相彼無能勝，
tgt: Moreover, the mark of his eye cannot be excelled.

src: 於諸有情平等觀矚。
tgt: With regard to sentient beings, it contemplates with equality.

src: 彼眼清淨離雜思惟，
tgt: The purity of his eye is free from confused thinking.

src: 彼眼無垢體性光瑩。
tgt: His eye, being stainless, is intrinsically radiant.

src: 又彼天眼隨其心意而能現前成熟佛眼，
tgt: Moreover, his eye, in accordance with his mental will, is able to bring to fruition, present in front of him, the Buddha-eye.

src: 眼無貪瞋離諸違順。
tgt: His eye, without lust and hatred, is free from resistance and acquiescence.

src: 又彼天眼於義境界修行法式如實相應，
tgt: Moreover, his eye, with regard to the object-spheres of meaning, cultivates the [proper] forms of Dharma which are truly appropriate.

src: 又於有情安住大悲。
tgt: Moreover, with regard to sentient beings, he abides in great compassion.

src: 又彼天眼來求丐者而無不與，
tgt: Moreover, his divine eye does not fail to give to those who come seeking alms.

src: 見破戒者亦無瞋怒，

src: 於墮落者而常守護， 於懈怠者而常勤策，

src: 為散亂者現禪定分， 為惡慧者示正慧眼，

src: 為邪道者開悟正道， 劣勝解者導以最上佛之知見。

src: 又彼天眼， 於一切智智最上神通， 於菩提道專注一境決定現前。

src: 舍利子！ 此名菩薩摩訶薩而能圓滿彼天眼通及智事業。

src: 時有比丘名和輪，

tgt: After that Buddha entered parinirvāṇa, that bhikṣu upheld this samādhi sūtra.

src: 我時作國王剎利種， 於夢中聞是三昧，
tgt: At that time I was a king, in the kṣatriya caste, and I heard of this samādhi sūtra in a dream.

src: 覺已便行， 求是比丘， 即依作沙門，
tgt: Upon waking, I immediately went to that bhikṣu and became a śramaṇa under him.

tgt: However, I was unable to hear it because time and again māra matters arose.” The Buddha told the bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, and upāsikās: “Hence I tell you all to learn this samādhi as soon as possible, never to lose it.

src: 善承事其師， 持是三昧， 至一劫、若百劫、若百千劫，
tgt: You should properly serve your teacher and uphold this samādhi sūtra for one kalpa, 100 kalpas, or even 100,000 kalpas, never negligent or indolent.

src: 莫得有懈倦。 守善師不離，
tgt: You should stay with a beneficent teacher and never leave him.

src: 若飲食資用， 衣被、床臥、珍寶以上勿有愛惜。
tgt: Do not begrudge food, drink, life-supporting goods, clothing, bedding, beds, or precious jewels.

src: 設無者當行乞食給師，
tgt: If you do not have any, you should beg for food and offer it to your teacher.

src: 趣當得是三昧莫厭，
tgt: Work tirelessly to attain this samādhi.

src: 常當自割身肉供養於善師， 何況寶物， 此不足言耳！
tgt: You should even cut off your own flesh to offer to your beneficent teacher, not to mention giving precious things.

src: 承事善師當如奴事大家，
tgt: Serve your beneficent teacher, like a slave serving a great family.

src: 求是三昧者當如是。
tgt: Those who seek this samādhi should act in this way.

src: 得三昧已， 當堅持常念師恩。
tgt: “Having attained this samādhi, one should abide in it and always remember the kindness of one’s teacher.

src: 是三昧難得值，
tgt: This samādhi sūtra is hard to encounter.

src: 正使求是三昧至百千劫， 但欲得聞其名不可得，
tgt: There are those who seek for 100,000 kalpas but cannot even hear the name of this samādhi.

tgt: The fire circle mantra is: oṁ agni śikhe svāhā ‘Then he rests this seal on the girl’s mouth and visualizes inside her mouth a circle of water (vārimaṇḍala), white in colour and shaped like a halfmoon, and recites the mantra seven times.

src: 真言曰： 「唵惹攞祖哩(二合)拏(引)摩抳娑嚩(二合引)賀」「次應移印按彼心中， 想地輪， 形方黃色， 誦七遍真言曰：
tgt: The mantra is: oṁ jala cūḍāmaṇi svāhā ‘Next, he should move the seal and rest it on her heart, visualizing a circle of earth (pṛthivīmaṇḍala), square in shape and yellow in colour, and reciting [the mantra] seven times.

src: 「唵摩賀麼攞跛囉訖囉(二合)摩娑嚩(二合引)賀」「次應移印按彼臍中， 想風輪， 其形圓黑色， 誦七遍真言曰： 「唵尾曩多(引)句攞曩那娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)」「次應以大印加持彼兩脚，
tgt: The mantra is: oṁ mahābala parākrama svāhā ‘Next, he should move the seal and rest it on her navel, visualizing a circle of wind (vāyumaṇḍala), circular in shape and black in colour, and reciting [the mantra] seven times.

src: 想迦樓羅， 誦真言曰： 「唵跛乞史(二合)囉(引)惹跛那娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)」「次應以大印， 誦甲冑真言， 加持童女， 遍身旋轉。
tgt: The mantra is: oṁ vinatākulana[n]da svāhā ‘Next, he should empower both her legs with the great seal, visualizing Garuḍa and reciting the mantra: oṁ pakṣirāja pada svāhā ‘Next, he should recite the armour mantra with the great seal to empower the girl, going around her entire body.

src: 真言曰： 「唵迦嚩左摩部(引)多(引)地跛帝娑嚩(二合引)賀」「行者次應自身為魔醯首羅天，
tgt: The mantra is: oṁ kavaca ma[hā]bhūtādhipate svāhā ‘The practitioner should next turn himself into the god Maheśvara.

src: 三目， 頭冠瓔珞莊嚴， 頭冠上有佛半月， 項上青， 十八臂， 手持種種器仗。 以龍為紳線，
tgt: He has three eyes, on his head there is a crown decorated with strings of jewels, and on top of the crown on his head are a Buddha and a halfmoon; his throat is blue, and he has eighteen arms, holding in his hands various weapons; he has a dragon (nāga) for a girdle tied together at the ends, and he also has a bloodsmeared elephanthide.

src: 角絡繫。 又彼塗血寫及， 須臾頃觀自身已， 次應以大印護彼童女一百八命節。
tgt: Having [thus] visualized himself in an instant, [the practitioner] should next protect the girl’s one hundred and eight lifenodes with the great seal.

src: 真言曰： 「唵(一)蜜哩(二合)體尾野(二合)吒多(二)惹縛(引)揄囉迦苫」「結其大印及誦真言， 遍身旋繞加持， 則護一百八種命節。
tgt: The mantra is: oṁ pṛthivyapastejovāyurākāśam ‘Binding the great seal and reciting [this] mantra, he empowers clockwise her entire body, thereby protecting the one hundred and eight kinds of lifenodes.

src: 「次又以大印真言加持花香及閼伽等。
tgt: ‘Next, again with the great seal and mantra, he empowers flowers, incense, argha, and so on.

src: 「次又以大印真言結十方界，
tgt: Next, again with the great seal and mantra, he binds the realms in the ten directions.

src: 則應對此童女前誦魔醯首羅使者真言曰： 「唎躋吒迦(一)麼多那(引)誐(二)尾灑娜跛拏(三)薩摩那誐囉(四)尾訖囉(二合)摩(五)尾羅(引)薩誐底(六)𠼝濟吒迦(七)布囉(二合)哩跛(引)擔囕(二合)(八)左羅左羅(九)左里左里(十)跛拏跛拏(十一)跛尼跛尼(十二)伴(上)爾伴爾(十三)羯恥羯恥(十四)阿尾捨阿尾捨(十五)𠼝躋吒迦(十六)嚕奴噌(二合)抧孃(二合)跋野底娑嚩(二合引)賀(十七)(引)」「此真言應誦七遍， 則彼童女戰動，
tgt: Then he should face the girl and recite the mantra of Maheśvara’s messenger: ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka matanāga viṣada[r]paṇa samānagara vikramavilāsagati ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka pratipātraṃ cala cala cali cali paṇa paṇa paṇi paṇi panni panni kaṭṭi kaṭṭi āviśa āviśa ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka rudro ‘jñāpayati svāhā ‘He should recite this mantra seven times, whereupon the girl will tremble.

src: 當知聖者入身，
tgt: Know that the Holy One has entered her body.

src: 則更彈指誦真言。
tgt: Then he further snaps his fingers and recites the mantra [again].

src: 若無現驗， 次誦摧迫使者真言曰： 「𠼝𠼝耶(一)摩魯呬多(二)(引)素囉素囉(三)(引)布爾多賀那賀那(四)波囉(二合)憾麼(二合引)那尼(五)那覩嚕(二合)尼都嚕(二合)尼(六)謨尼謨尼(七)伴(上)爾伴(上)爾(八)羯恥羯恥(九)阿尾捨阿尾捨(十)𠼝躋吒迦(十一)嚕奴噌(二合)枳孃(二合)跛野帝(十二)娑嚩(二合引)訶(十三)(引)」「誦此真言必速應驗。
tgt: If there is no apparent effect, he next recites the mantra for coercing the messenger: ḷ[ṁ] ḷ[ṁ] yamalohitasurāsurapūjita hana hana brahmānaṇina truṇi truṇi moṇi moṇi panni panni kaṭṭi kaṭṭi āviśa āviśa ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka rudro ‘jñāpayati svāhā ‘If he recites this mantra, there will most certainly be a swift effect in response, and he may ask about future good and evil and all favourable and unfavourable omens.

src: 問未來善惡一切災祥， 若不語或語遲， 則結棒印。 「二手合掌， 二無名指外支， 二中指並立，
tgt: If [the messenger] does not speak [through the girl], or speaks slowly, then he binds the staff seal (daṇḍamudrā): the two hands are clasped together, the two ring fingers are intercrossed outwards, the two middle fingers are raised side by side, the two forefingers are each hooked over the tips of the ring fingers, and the two thumbs each press down on the middle [fingers], intercrossed.

src: 二頭指各鉤無名指頭， 二大指各令押中交。 誦真言曰： 「唵(一)母那誐(二合)囉(二)都嚕都嚕(三)娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)(四)」「結此棒印， 則語問種種事已， 以大印真言加持閼伽， 三灑童女面，
tgt: Recite the mantra: oṁ mudgara turu turu svāhā ‘Bind this staff seal, and then when you have finished asking about various matters, empower the argha with the great seal and mantra, and sprinkle it three times on the girl’s face, whereupon she will be released.

src: 即結解。 此使者真言， 先應誦一萬遍則法成， 則見身來，
tgt: ‘This messenger’s mantra should have been recited ten thousand times previously, and then the rite will be successful, that is, you will see him come in person.

src: 須獻閼伽乞願： 『願聖者一切處一切時使用皆辦。
tgt: You must offer him argha and make your wish: that you wish to employ the Holy One in all places and at all times to attend to everything.

src: 』則隱不現。
tgt: He will then vanish and be no longer visible.

src: 已後欲使， 塗一小壇著香花飲食， 誦真言一百八遍， 則現身。
tgt: Thereafter, when you wish to employ him, mark out a small altar, place on it incense, flowers, food, and drink, and recite the mantra one hundred and eight times, whereupon he will appear in person.

src: 則言龍宮中取長年藥、如意寶珠， 或使夜摩王處延命增益壽命， 或使上取妙甘露， 或使他國問其善惡，
tgt: Then tell him to fetch the elixir of longevity or wishfulfilling gem from the dragon palace, or dispatch him to the place of King Yama to prolong your life and increase your life span, or dispatch him [to heaven] above to fetch wondrous nectar, or dispatch him to other countries to inquire about their good and bad points.

src: 亦能助軍陣摧破他敵，
tgt: He can also help an army to destroy its enemies.

src: 種種使用悉能成辦。
tgt: Employ him in various ways, and he will be able to accomplish everything.

src: 此法一切迦樓羅法中最殊勝， 祕密難得。
tgt: ‘This rite is the most excellent among all Garuḍa rites, secret and difficult to obtain.

src: 汝當揀擇法器堪傳授者而傳與，
tgt: You should select a Dharmavessel worthy of being initiated and transmit it to him.

src: 非人器人即損他， 已後此法不成。
tgt: If you transmit it to someone who is not a [suitable] vessel, then it will harm him and thereafter the rite will not work [for you either].

src: 是故應極祕密， 勿妄傳受之。
tgt: Therefore it must be kept most secret and must not be transmitted recklessly.

src: 大自在天迦樓羅陀羅尼曰： 「那謨婆伽嚩底(一)嚕馱囉野(二)瞋那劫波囉野(三)薩嚩微那延迦囉野(四)薩嚩羯摩莎馱那野(五)薩嚩嚩尸迦羅拏野(六)薩嚩設覩嚕(二合)尾那捨那野(七)唵(八)迦波羅質擔瞋那迦波羅部擔(九)嚕訥嚕(二合)枳孃(二合)跛野帝(十)娑嚩(二合引)賀」「此陀羅尼， 調伏人取赤芭蕉葉畫彼人，
tgt: ‘The garuḍa dhāraṇī of Maheśvara is: namo bhagavate rudrāya chinnakapālāya sarvavinayaṅkarāya sarvakarmasādhanāya sarvavaśīkaraṇāya sarva śatruvināśanāya oṁ kapālacitaṃ chinnakapālabhūtaṃ rudro ‘jñāpayati svāhā ‘To subjugate someone [with] this dhāraṇī take a red banana leaf, draw that person [on it], inscribe his name on the [figure’s] heart, recite the dhāraṇī one hundred and eight times, and then bury it in cow dung, whereupon he will be subjugated.

src: 心上書名字， 誦陀羅尼一百八遍， 即埋牛糞中， 即調伏。 欲令竪子對相憎， 多羅葉畫彼男女形， 書名相背， 取線纏， 取鼠狼毛、山鷄毛、蛇退皮燒熏，
tgt: ‘If you wish to make foolish people hate each other, draw the figures of the man and the woman on a tāla (palm) leaf, inscribe their names back to back, take a cord to tie it, take the hairs of rats and wolves, the feathers of pheasants, and the discarded skins of snakes, burn them, fumigate [the leaf], recite the dhāraṇī one hundred and eight times, place it inside a kapāla (skull), and then bury it in charnel grounds, whereupon they will hate each other.

src: 誦陀羅尼一百八遍， 安劫波羅中， 即於屍林中埋著， 便相憎。 除却依舊。
tgt: If you remove [the leaf], they will revert to their former state.

src: 若令相憐者， 還於多羅葉上畫彼夫形，
tgt: ‘If you [wish to] make people love each other, then draw the figures of the husband [and wife?]

src: 書名相合， 取白線繫， 取雀兒毛、蛇皮燒熏， 誦陀羅尼一百八遍， 即相憐。
tgt: on a tāla leaf, inscribe their names merged together, take a white cord to tie it, take sparrows’ feathers and snakes’ skins, burn them, fumigate [the leaf], and recite the dhāraṇī one hundred and eight times, whereupon they will love each other.

src: 「又法欲令人相打， 於大虫皮或於牛皮， 畫二人相把頭髻， 書名著， 取線纏著，
tgt: ‘Another rite: if you wish to make people fight each other, on the skin of a tiger or on oxhide draw two people grabbing each other’s hair, inscribe their names, take a cord to tie it, fumigate it over a fire, and bury it under a mortar, whereupon they will fight each other daily.

src: 於火上重， 埋碓臼下， 即得日日相打， 除劫止。
tgt: If you remove [the leaf], they will stop [fighting].

src: 「又法若欲調伏人者， 取貝多葉上畫人形、書名， 誦陀羅尼一百八遍， 即於床下埋， 即得調伏。
tgt: ‘Another rite: if you wish to subjugate someone, take a palm leaf, draw the person’s figure on it, inscribe his name, recite the dhāraṇī one hundred and eight times, and then bury it under his bed, whereupon you will succeed in subjugating him.

src: 「又法令尿血者， 取多羅葉畫彼人， 書姓名， 取釘誦陀羅尼一百八遍釘上， 七七日即得除去。
tgt: ‘Another rite: to make someone pass blood in his urine, take a tāla leaf, draw that person, inscribe his name, take a nail, recite the dhāraṇī one hundred and eight times [over it], and nail [the leaf] down for seven weeks, whereupon you can remove it.

src: 「次說眼藥法。
tgt: ‘Next, I shall explain a rite for eye ointment.

src: 若調伏竪子者， 取蛇頭、竭羅安善那、青木香、寫甲蜂二介， 於黑月十四日擣作抹， 和肉點眼角，
tgt: If you [wish to] subjugate foolish people, take a snake’s head, gara (poison), añjana (collyrium), costus root, weevils, and two bees, on the fourteenth day of the dark [half]month pound them to make powder, mix it with meat, and apply it in the corner of the eye.

src: 一切竪子隨逐， 天上亦來， 非但人間也。 」
tgt: All foolish people will follow you, and those in heaven above will also come, not just those in the human realm.’ [Here ends] The Garuḍa Āveśa Rite Explained by the God Maheśvara Which Swiftly Establishes Its Efficacy in one roll.

src: 以是因緣， 故名為大。
tgt: For this reason it is called great.

src: 大分深義， 所謂空也。
tgt: One of the profoundest teachings of Mahāyāna is called emptiness.

src: 若能通達是義， 即通達大乘， 具足六波羅蜜，
tgt: If one can understand this doctrine, he can understand Mahāyāna and possess the six pāramitās without hindrance.

src: 無所障礙， 是故我今但解釋空。
tgt: Therefore, I want only to explain emptiness.

src: 解釋空者， 當以十二門入於空義。
tgt: To explain emptiness and enter into its meaning one should use the Twelve Gate [Treatise].

src: 初是因緣門，
tgt: The first gate is concerned with causal conditions.

src: 所謂： 眾緣所生法， 是即無自性；
tgt: It is said, Things are produced from various conditions, and hence have no self-nature.

src: 若無自性者， 云何有是法？
tgt: If they have no self-nature, how can there be such things?

src: 眾緣所生法有二種： 一者內， 二者外。
tgt: All things produced by various conditions are of two kinds, one internal and the other external.

src: 眾緣亦有二種： 一者內， 二者外。
tgt: All conditions are also of two kinds, one internal and the other external.

src: 外因緣者， 如泥團、輪繩、陶師等和合， 故有瓶生；
tgt: External causal conditions are, for example, clay, turning string and a craftsman; together they produce a jar.

src: 又如縷繩、機杼、織師等和合，
tgt: As another example, a rug is produced from the causal conditions of yarn, a loom and a weaver.

src: 故有疊生； 又如治地、築基梁、椽、泥、草、人功等和合， 故有舍生；
tgt: Similarly, site preparation, foundation, poles, wood, mud, grass and labor are examples of external causal conditions; together they produce a house.

src: 又如酪器、鑽搖、人功等和合， 故有酥生；
tgt: Still other examples are milk, a curdling vat and labor; they are combined to produce cheese.

src: 又如種子、地、水、火、風、虛空、時節、人功等和合， 故有芽生；
tgt: Again, seed, earth, water, sunshine, wind, air, seasons and labor are combined to produce the sprout.

src: 當知外緣等法皆亦如是。
tgt: One should know that the so-called external causal conditions are all like these.

src: 內因緣者， 所謂無明、行、識、名色、六入、觸、受、愛、取、有、生、老死， 各各先因而後生。
tgt: The so-called internal causal conditions are ignorance, action, consciousness, name-form, the six sense faculties, touch, feeling, desire, clinging, formation of being, birth and old age, death; each has a cause first and then is produced.

src: 如是內外諸法皆從眾緣生，
tgt: Thus both internal and external things are produced by various conditions.

src: 從眾緣生故， 即非是無性耶！
tgt: Since they are produced by various conditions, is it not true that they have no self-nature?

src: 若法自性無， 他性亦無， 自他亦無。
tgt: Now if a thing has no self-nature, it cannot have other-nature nor both self-nature and other-nature.

src: 何以故？
tgt: Why?

src: 因他性故無自性。
tgt: Because the so-called other-nature has, in fact, no self-nature.

src: 若謂以他性故有者， 則牛以馬性有， 馬以牛性有， 梨以柰性有， [＊]柰以梨性有，
tgt: If we say that something exists because of other-nature, then a cow exists because of horse nature; a horse exists because of cow nature; a peach exists because of apple nature; an apple exists because of peach nature, and so on.

src: 餘皆應爾， 而實不然。
tgt: [They are all] really impossible.

src: 若謂不以他性故有， 但因他故有者，
tgt: One might say that something exists not because of a certain other-nature, but because of a certain other.

src: 是亦不然。
tgt: But this cannot be the case either.

src: 何以故？
tgt: Why?

src: 若以蒲故有席者， 則蒲、席一體， 不名為他；
tgt: If one says that a mat exists because of a certain grass, then the grass and the mat would be one body, and the grass could not be called other.

src: 若謂蒲於席為他者， 不得言以蒲故有席。
tgt: If one says that the grass is other with respect to the mat, then he could not claim that the mat exists because of the grass.

src: 又蒲亦無自性。
tgt: Moreover, the so-called grass has no self-nature either.

src: 何以故？
tgt: Why?

src: 蒲亦從眾緣出，
tgt: Because the grass is also produced from various conditions.

src: 故無自性。 無自性故， 不得言以蒲性故有席，
tgt: Since grass has no self-nature, one cannot say that because of grass nature the mat exists.

src: 是故席不應以蒲為體。
tgt: Therefore, the mat cannot have grass as its substance.

src: 餘瓶、酥等外因緣生法， 皆亦如是不可得。
tgt: Thus, for the same reason the production of a jar, cheese and other things from external causal conditions cannot be established.

src: 內因緣生法， 皆亦如是不可得，
tgt: Similarly, production by internal causal conditions cannot be established.

src: 如《七十論》中說： 緣法實無生； 若謂為有生，
tgt: As it is stated in the Seventy Treatise, [Twelve chains of] causal conditions really have no production.

src: 為在一心中； 為在多心中？
tgt: If they have production, do they have it in one mind-moment or in many mindmoments?

src: 是十二因緣法實自無生。
tgt: The so-called twelve causal conditions really and originally have no production.

src: 若謂有生， 為一心中有？ 為眾心中有？
tgt: If there is production, does it occur in one mindmoment or in many mind-moments?

src: 若一心中有者， 因果即一時共生。 又因果一時有，
tgt: If it occurs in one-moment, then a cause and an effect would happen together at the same time.

src: 是事不然。
tgt: But this is impossible.

src: 何以故？
tgt: Why?

src: 凡物先因後果故。
tgt: Because a cause is prior to an effect.

src: 若眾心中有者， 十二因緣法則各各別異，
tgt: If production occurs in many mind-moments, then the twelve causal conditions would be distinct from one another.

src: 先分共心滅已，
tgt: Each of the earlier ones would occur within a particular mind-moment and disappear with that mind-moment.

src: 後分誰為因緣？
tgt: Then, what would be the causal condition of the later ones?

src: 滅法無所有， 何得為因？
tgt: Since what disappears with a particular mind-moment is non-existent, how can it affect others?

src: 十二因緣法若先有者， 應若一心、若多心，
tgt: If there are twelve causal conditions, they should either be in one mind-moment or in many mind-moments.

src: 二俱不然。
tgt: But neither is possible.

src: 是故眾緣皆空。
tgt: Therefore, all conditions are empty.

src: 緣空故， 從緣生法亦空，
tgt: Since conditions are empty, things produced by conditions are also empty.

src: 是故當知一切有為法皆空。
tgt: Thus, one should know all created things are empty.

src: 有為法尚空， 何況我耶？
tgt: If created things are empty, how much more so with the self?

src: 因五陰、十二入、十八界有為法故說有我，
tgt: Because of created things such as the five skandhas, the twelve sense fields (ayatana) and the eighteen elements (dhatu), one can say there is the self.
